thread:
maya-sec: Scanner alert: bucket "redwood-backups-prod" returned public READ ACL in the scheduled bucket-scan at 2026-06-15T09:00Z. Possible ACL drift or tooling bug. @sam-sre can you triage?

sam-sre: On it. Pulling ACL + policy now.

sam-sre: `aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-backups-prod` shows Grants: AllUsers -> READ. Policy attached is empty/no deny.

lisa-iam: That bucket is owned by `svc-backup` role. Checking IAM and recent changes.

maya-sec: Temporary mitigation: applying block public access + lock down ACLs. Running:

```
aws s3api put-public-access-block \
  --bucket redwood-backups-prod \
  --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
```

sam-sre: I applied `put-public-access-block` and removed the public ACL: `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-backups-prod --acl private` — confirmed.

sam-sre: Also added a short-term bucket policy to explicitly deny public access and require SSE:KMS for puts.

maya-sec: Thanks. Root cause still unknown — terraform shows no recent PR touching that bucket.

devops: Looking at CloudTrail events: found `aws s3api put-bucket-acl --acl public-read` executed at 1776543200 by principal `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/svc-backup` (service job). That matches time window.

devops: Looks like a backup job invoked a CLI call with wrong flag. No terraform change — manual/tooling action.

lisa-iam: That role had a broad managed policy `svc-backup-full-s3` with `s3:*` — removing that now. Will replace with least-privilege: `s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket` scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-backups-prod/*` and bucket prefix.

sam-sre: Policy updated. Also adding conditions: `aws:SecureTransport` and require `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption` on PutObject.

maya-sec: Audit steps: exporting CloudTrail events to `s3://sec-incident-redwood/1776543210/` and snapshotting logs for forensics.

patrick-eng: For Terraform drift: state won't show manual ACL changes. Suggest we add an `aws_s3_bucket_acl` resource or manage the ACL via `aws_s3_bucket` with `acl = "private"` so future drift is prevented. Also add CI checks to prevent manual `put-bucket-acl` in jobs.

devops: Agreed. We'll add a terraform resource to enforce `acl = "private"` and add an automated remediation in the backup job to strip any ACLs post-run just in case.

patrick-eng: Suggest CI guardrail: fail builds that include `--acl public-read` or `put-bucket-acl` in backup job scripts. Also open an OPA policy to block `public-read` ACLs in IaC.

lisa-iam: KMS follow-up: bucket currently not using KMS. Plan: create CMK `alias/rdw/backups` with a key policy that only allows the backup role to encrypt and the security team to manage. Update backup job to use SSE-KMS and add a bucket policy that denies PutObject without `sse` header.

maya-sec: Communication: CISO and Privacy notified. Drafted internal blurb. No customer notice planned yet — need impact analysis.

sam-sre: Quick risk check: access logs show zero GET requests to the bucket during exposure window. Objects were not listed publicly. Still running a full object list vs access logs to be safe.

devops: Running `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups-prod --recursive` and comparing to access logs; will post results in the incident ticket.

maya-sec: Post-incident actions (summary):
- Short term: block public access, remove public ACL, restrict role permissions, enable SSE-KMS on bucket.
- Mid term: update IaC to manage ACL/policy, CI guardrails, automated monthly scans + CloudTrail alerts for `s3:PutBucketAcl` events.
- Long term: evaluate moving backups to VPC-only storage or access-proxy, enforce KMS with key rotation and stricter key policy.

lisa-iam: I'll open PR for IAM changes and the KMS plan. @devops please include terraform changes to manage the bucket and the new CMK.

devops: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/428 — contains `aws_s3_bucket` ACL enforcement and new `aws_kms_key` resource for backups.

patrick-eng: Scheduling a 1-hr postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please add action owners to the incident ticket.

maya-sec: Labels: `severity=low-medium`, `root_cause=manual-tooling-flag`, `impact=potential-read-acl`, `mitigated=true`.

deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-234. Owners assigned.

lisa-iam: I'll follow up with the key policy draft and PR link.

maya-sec: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll close the thread once postmortem notes and PRs are merged.
